occurrences.quote: The claim states Max Gail "had a role in the TV series Carl Levitt," which is factually incorrect. According to Passage [2], "Carl Levitt" is not a TV series title—it is a character name.

From Passage [2]: Ron Carey (not Max Gail) "was best known for playing ambitious NYPD Police Officer Carl Levitt on TV's 'Barney Miller'." The passage explicitly states that Max Gail was one of the series' stars on "Barney Miller" but does NOT say Max Gail played Carl Levitt.

**Film claim - UNVERIFIED**: While Passage [1] confirms that Jim Moody played Arnie in the 1983 film "D.C. Cab", there is no passage evidence that Max Gail appeared in this film. This part of the claim cannot be verified from the provided passages.

**Second assertion - "He also had a role in the TV series Carl Levitt"**: This contains a clear factual error. Passage [2] explicitly states that "Carl Levitt" is a character name (an "NYPD Police Officer"), not a TV series title.

While Passage [2] confirms Max Gail was indeed a star of "Barney Miller," he played Detective Stan "Wojo" Wojciehowicz, not Carl Levitt. The claim conflates a character name with a series title and misattributes Max Gail's role.

**First assertion - "Max Gail starred in the film that Jim Moody played Arnie in"**: Passage [3] confirms that Max Gail starred in "D.C. Cab" (1983). However, none of the provided passages mention Jim Moody or a character named Arnie.
